title: Product Market Characteristics and the Choice between IPOs and Acquisitions

rival_explanations: Access to private funding proxies for unobservable firm quality that directly drives the exit decision (selection/screening rather than a causal effect of funding)

context.sample_size: 2,578 IPO firms (1,315 matched to LRD) and 9,677 private-firm acquisition transactions

data_sources.name: Manufacturing Plant Ownership Change Database (OCD), U.S. Census Bureau
Standard Statistical Establishment List (SSEL), U.S. Census Bureau
Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP)
Reuters Loan Pricing Corporation's DealScan database
